name: Apple M3 Pro (MacBook Pro 16-inch, Nov 2023)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: '150GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M3 Pro with 12-core CPU / 18-core GPU. Unified-memory bandwidth, package-level, shared with the CPU.
notes: M3 Pro: 18-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, up to 36GB unified memory. The 150GB/s bandwidth is the lowest among M-series Pro/Max/Ultra parts. For local LLM inference, 36GB unified memory can hold a 13B model at 4-bit (~7GB weights) comfortably, or a 7B model at 8-bit (~7GB weights) with room for long context. The 150GB/s bandwidth yields roughly 15-25 tokens/sec for a 13B model at 4-bit. The M3 Pro is the budget Apple Silicon option for local inference.
